# Migration notes for stack render-import

Generated from render. Review the documents in a pull request, then run `levelrail-cli stack plan render-import -f .` before the first apply.

## What the files do not do

- Apply runs prebuilt images only. An app with no image on the source is named after the `--image-repo` you gave, and nothing builds it: push that image from your CI first.
- Secret values, volumes, scheduled jobs and database contents are not carried over by the documents.
- Databases are created empty. Copy the data in with the data copy step (dashboard: Settings, Import from another platform; CLI: migrate db-copy), which verifies row counts.
- service api: value generated by Render and not readable, set it manually: JWT_SALT
- Render cron job nightly runs "node jobs/nightly.js" on schedule "0 3 * * *": create it as a scheduled task on the app that holds the same code
- Render Postgres main-db uses plan basic_256mb with 15 GB of disk: pick a matching size here, data is not migrated
- Render Key Value cache uses plan starter: pick a matching size and Redis version here, data is not migrated

## App api

- no port found in the source, defaulted to 80
- the app builds from git; it is created without a running build
- secret variables with no readable value were skipped: JWT_SALT
- volumes are created empty, their data is not migrated
- Render build command is "npm ci"
- Render start command is "npm start"
- Render auto-deploys on every push
- Render plan is starter
- next: set the correct port in the app settings
- next: connect the repository https://github.com/acme/api (main), set credentials if it is private, then run a build
- next: set them with the secrets command
- next: copy the data into the new volumes before starting (CLI: migrate volumes --source user@host prints the commands)
- next: set the same build command after import
- next: set the same start command after import
- next: connect the repository webhook after import
- next: pick a matching memory and CPU size after import
- volume data mounted at /var/data is not in the documents: volumes are not supported by apply yet

## App mailer

- no port found in the source, defaulted to 80
- Render background worker, not exposed over HTTP
- Render plan is starter
- next: set the correct port in the app settings
- next: create it as a worker from the same source with the start command below
- next: pick a matching memory and CPU size after import

## App site

- no port found in the source, defaulted to 80
- the app builds from git; it is created without a running build
- Render build command is "npm run build"
- Render publish directory is "dist"
- next: set the correct port in the app settings
- next: connect the repository https://github.com/acme/site (trunk), set credentials if it is private, then run a build
- next: set the same build command after import
- next: serve the same directory after import
